title: Gur Sikh Temple

services.name: Past Exhibitions
services.desc: “Haq” means rights in Punjabi, Hindi, and Urdu. This bilingual (English-Punjabi) travelling exhibit, developed by SASI and the Royal BC Museum, seeks to preserve and share communities’ perspectives on their diverse history. Since its launch in 2022 as part of the South Asian Canadian Legacy Project (SACLP), it has travelled across BC, with each presenting organisation contributing research on their local South Asian Canadian community histories. These contributions come together at the Sikh Heritage Museum in Abbotsford for what is, in many ways, a homecoming. The exhibit is free to visit and will be open for visiting from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm till June 2027. Date: June 2026 - June 2027Time:
